teaser.en: Its flowers smell so sweet that they are woven into wedding wreaths and used to make perfume.
teaser.sw: Maua yake yananukia vizuri kiasi kwamba husukwa katika mashada ya maua ya harusi na hutumika kutengeneza manukato.
teaser.dg: Maruwage gana arufu nono sana, hata nkusukwa mashada ga harusi na nkuhumirwa kuhenda marashi.

summary.en: *Chilua* is the mkilua, a small coastal tree famous for its powerfully scented yellow-orange flowers. Found only on the East African coast, it is used for perfume and wedding wreaths and is listed as Vulnerable.
summary.sw: *Chilua* ni mkilua, mti mdogo wa pwani maarufu kwa maua yake ya manjano-machungwa yenye harufu kali. Unapatikana tu katika pwani ya Afrika Mashariki, hutumika kwa manukato na mashada ya maua ya harusi, na umeorodheshwa kama Hatarini (Vulnerable).
summary.dg: *Chilua* (kpwa Chiswahili *mkilua*) ni muhi mdide wa pwani unaomanyikana sana kpwa maruwage ga rangi ya mandano na chungbwa genye arufu kali. Chinaphahikana pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki bahi; nkuhumirwa kuhenda marashi na mashada ga harusi, na chikaandikpwa dza *Vulnerable* (hatarini).

about.en:
*Chilua* is a shrub or small tree up to about 8 m. Its large leaves sit on very short stalks along the branches. The flowers are the reason people know it: pale yellow to orange, hanging on long stalks beneath the leaves, with a strong, sweet scent that carries far on a warm evening.

After flowering it bears clusters of red, finger-like fruit segments, typical of the custard-apple family.
about.sw:
*Chilua* ni kichaka au mti mdogo unaofikia urefu wa takriban m 8. Majani yake makubwa hukaa kwenye vikonyo vifupi sana kando ya matawi. Maua ndiyo sababu watu wanaujua: ya manjano hafifu hadi rangi ya machungwa, yakining'inia kwenye vikonyo virefu chini ya majani, yenye harufu kali na tamu inayofika mbali jioni yenye joto.

Baada ya kuchanua huzaa vishada vya vipande vyekundu vya tunda vinavyofanana na vidole, kama ilivyo kawaida ya familia ya mitopetope.
about.dg:
*Chilua* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide unaokula hadi phephi mita 8. Makodzage makulu ganamera kanda-kanda ya pandaze, dzulu ya milita mifupi sana. Maruwage ndigo ganayohenda atu achimanye: ni ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu hadi rangi ya chungbwa, ganagbwadzika photsi ya makodza dzulu ya milita mire, na gana arufu kali na nono inayophiya kure dziloni kuchikala na dzoho.

Bada ya maruwa chinalavya matunda ga kundu ganayomera phamwenga, genye vipande dza vyala; ndivyo irivyo kpwa mimea ya jamii ya *mbokwe*.

where.en: It grows wild in moist evergreen coastal forest on sandy soil, and is also kept near homes for its scent. It is found only along the East African coast.
where.sw: Huota porini katika misitu ya pwani yenye unyevu ya kijani mwaka mzima, kwenye udongo wa mchanga, na pia hupandwa karibu na nyumba kwa ajili ya harufu yake. Unapatikana tu kando ya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Chinamera chenyewe kpwenye matsaka ga pwani genye madzi-madzi na makodza chila wakati, kpwenye tsi ya mtsanga, na piya nkuphandwa phephi na nyumba kpwa sababu ya arufuye. Chinaphahikana pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki bahi.

uses.en: The flowers are used to make perfume and are woven into wreaths for weddings. The roots are used in traditional medicine, and the stems as posts.
uses.sw: Maua yake hutumika kutengeneza manukato na husukwa katika mashada ya maua ya harusi. Mizizi hutumika katika dawa za kienyeji, na mashina kama nguzo.
uses.dg: Maruwa nkuhumirwa kuhenda marashi na nkusukwa mashada ga harusi. Mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji, na makolo nkuhumirwa dza viguzo.

culture.en: Its name comes from *lua*, 'flower', a fitting name for a plant whose blossoms are its whole reputation. Its place in wedding wreaths links it to celebration and beauty on the coast.
culture.sw: Jina lake linatokana na *lua*, 'ua', jina linalofaa kwa mmea ambao umaarufu wake wote unatokana na maua yake. Nafasi yake katika mashada ya maua ya harusi inauhusisha na sherehe na urembo wa pwani.
culture.dg: Dzinare rinalavywa kula *lua*, 'ruwa', dzina rinalofwaha kpwa mmea ambao maruwage ndigo sifwaye yosi. Kpwa kukala ganahumirwa kpwenye mashada ga harusi, chinatambukiza atu sherehe na uzuri pwani.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chilua*; ICRAF's handbook gives *chingade*. In Swahili it is *mkilua* or *mlua*, and in Giriama *mkilua*. The Swahili name has also become its scientific genus name, *Mkilua fragrans*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *chilua*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *chingade*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkilua* au *mlua*, na kwa Kigiriama *mkilua*. Jina la Kiswahili limekuwa pia jina la jenasi yake ya kisayansi, *Mkilua fragrans*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *chilua*; chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *chingade*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkilua* au *mlua*, na kpwa Chigiriama ni *mkilua*. Dzina ra Chiswahili piya rikakala dzina ra jenasi ya chisayansi, *Mkilua fragrans*.

conservation.en: *Chilua* is listed as Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List and is endemic to the East African coast, so the remaining wild plants in coastal forest matter.
conservation.sw: *Chilua* umeorodheshwa kama Hatarini (Vulnerable) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN na ni mmea wa pekee wa pwani ya Afrika Mashariki, kwa hiyo mimea iliyobaki porini katika misitu ya pwani ina umuhimu mkubwa.
conservation.dg: *Chilua* chikaandikpwa dza *Vulnerable* (hatarini) kpwenye IUCN Red List, na chinaphahikana pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki bahi, kpwa hivyo mimea iriyosala ya chienyeji kpwenye matsaka ga pwani ina samani sana.

reason.en: Isolona, a related forest tree, also Vulnerable
reason.sw: *Isolona*, mti jamaa wa msituni, nao uko Hatarini (Vulnerable)
reason.dg: *Isolona*, muhi wa tsaka wa jamii mwenga, na piya uri hatarini

reason.sw: *Uvariodendron*, jamaa mwingine wa familia ya mitopetope

reason.en: Henna, another plant used in wedding adornment
reason.sw: Hina, mmea mwingine unaotumika katika urembo wa harusi
reason.dg: *Hina*, mmea wanjina unaohumirwa kudzipamba kpwenye harusi
